name: Minamitane (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Minamitane town emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings beneath a crown-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Minamitane, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Minamitane town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings beneath a crown-like device
